messages:
Nora: Heads-up Enterprise Zeta wants a formal "stability SLA + pin" for their onboarding. They want model locked for 75 days, embargoed auto-upgrades, and guaranteed p95 latency during business hours. Need playbook and SOW language.
Diego: 75 days is long. Recommend we call it a "stability window" with carve-outs: emergency security/safety patches allowed, and micro-patches that don't change output semantics.
Rhea: Bench ask from customer: they want a focused regressions suite on their critical flows (~2k prompts) + a small out-of-distribution probe. Pass thresholds on quality/regression and latency.
Calvin: Operationally: propose canary plan: mirror 10% for 48h, then 3% -> 20% -> 60% over 96h with checkpoints at each step. Rollback triggers: quality_regression_rate > 1% OR p95 latency delta > 150ms OR error-rate delta > 0.5%.
Nora: Draft bench spec (compact):
```
bench_name: zeta-stability-window
samples: 2000
metrics:
  - quality_regression_rate
  - p95_latency_ms_delta
  - tokens_per_response_delta
pass_criteria:
  - quality_regression_rate <= 1.0%
  - p95_latency_ms_delta <= 150
  - tokens_per_response_delta <= baseline * 1.25
reporting: per-route + business-hour bucket
```
Diego: Who signs off? Eng-ML runs + certifies bench; Product curates prompt set and signs customer acceptance; Eng-Platform owns canary automation and rollback hooks. Eng-Infra to approve reserved capacity for business hours.
Rhea: Commercial asks: Zeta requests a small prepaid rollback fund (rollback-credit) and a 20% onboarding credit for the first stability window. They also asked for explicit audit logs of any rollback actions.
eng-platform-bot: INFO: Canary template "enterprise-stability-v1" exists. Rollback-credit ledger feature flagged (#FR-6102).
Calvin: For rollback-credit accounting: propose prepaid 300k tokens; Eng-Platform consumes during rollback to backfill traffic. Overage billed at migration rate. Need SOW text.
Nora: Legal: we need a stability-window clause: auto-expire after 75 days, emergency-patch carve-outs, rollback-credit handling, notice periods (48h for planned changes), and audit/logging obligations.
Legal Bot: REMINDER: Include definitions for "micro-patch" vs "breaking upgrade", billing for rollback-credit overages, retention period for audit logs, and export-control/data-residency confirmations.
Diego: Remediation policy: allow up to 2 remediation runs (customer + Eng-ML) within a 14-day remediation window. If still failing, product to present options: paid migration engagement, extended lock at cost, or revert.
Rhea: Can we define an "immutable seed set" for their bench so we can defend against disputes? Customer expects seeds to be immutable and stored with checksums.
Calvin: Yes bench runner will snapshot model hash, quantization profile, seed set, and produce signed bench report. We'll attach it to the SOW artifacts.
Nora: SLO detail: they want p95 < X ms during business hours or a small SLA credit. Product to negotiate exact number; for now capture the mechanism in SOW.
Diego: Communication plan: 1) Eng-ML to run bench by Fri EOD. 2) Eng-Platform to validate canary automation + rollback-credit flow. 3) Eng-Infra to estimate reserved capacity cost. 4) Legal to draft clause in 3 business days. 5) Product to draft SOW & comms.
Rhea: One more: include a deprecation path post-window: 30-day migration runway with hand-holding credits if we later require customers to move for safety reasons.
Legal Bot: REMINDER: Also include termination rights, dispute resolution for bench disagreements, and acceptance criteria for remediation success.
Nora: Thanks team  I'll assemble the draft SOW and include the bench YAML, rollback-credit example, and the immutable-seed checksum. Will post outputs here. :thumbsup:
